description: This file contains CLI command implementations for authentication workflows in the litellm proxy client, including login, logout, and user info commands, with utilities for token management, team selection, and polling-based authentication.

methods.name: get_token_file_path
methods.description: Determines the file path for storing the authentication token.

methods.name: save_token
methods.description: Saves token data to a JSON file with restricted permissions.

methods.name: load_token
methods.description: Loads token data from the token file if it exists and is valid.

methods.name: clear_token
methods.description: Removes the stored token file to clear authentication.

methods.name: get_stored_api_key
methods.description: Retrieves the stored API key via an SDK utility.

methods.name: display_teams_table
methods.description: Displays a list of teams in a formatted table.

methods.name: get_key_input
methods.description: Captures a single key press from the user in a cross-platform manner.

methods.name: display_interactive_team_selection
methods.description: Displays teams with one highlighted for user selection.

methods.name: prompt_team_selection
methods.description: Provides an interactive or fallback method for team selection.

methods.name: prompt_team_selection_fallback
methods.description: Fallback method for team selection in non-interactive environments.

methods.name: _poll_for_authentication
methods.description: Polls the server for authentication completion and handles team selection if required.

methods.name: _handle_team_selection_during_polling
methods.description: Handles team selection during polling and re-polls with selected team ID.

methods.name: _render_and_prompt_for_team_selection
methods.description: Displays team options and prompts user to select a team.

methods.name: login
methods.description: CLI command to initiate login via SSO, including browser opening and polling for completion.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: CLI command to clear stored authentication tokens.

methods.name: whoami
methods.description: CLI command to display current authentication status and token age.
